about: The rules of the floor and the modules that scripts/holders.mjs counts as having no holder, each with its proposal (AGENTS.md, "Rules are pruned by their numbers"; #545), worst first: a rule read at a role's start before one read on need. "mark": "check" (a check that never guesses could hold it, a maintained linter's rule first where one reads the breach), "case" (only a staged case could), "move" (to a module read on need), "goes" (kept in the archive with its reason, free to return), or "describes" (it binds no one, and holders.json should say so). "form": beside a case, a move or a removal, a slightly different form of the rule whose breach a check reads without guessing, or "noForm": why none exists (AGENTS.md, "A rule is written in the form a check can hold"; #887). "by": the queued issue that builds the check or case, or "project" for a check a project of that kind keeps; a check or case with none has no issue filed yet, since its upkeep does not pay yet or the owner's answer comes first; the owner decides moves and removals, a few at a time. A floor rule is never proposed to go. Sorted first on 17 November 2026; each pruning's session brings it up to date.
